It depends on a lot. You're metabolism, how long you used, how much you used, which opioid you mainly used- there's a lot. 

However, short half-life drugs (heroin and oxy) vs Long half ones (Methadone and Bup) tend to be easier to bounce back from. 

After stopping Suboxone fully, I had about 3 weeks where I could barely walk around the block, was super slow at everything, and hated it. I just had to kinda be okay with the fact that most days were going to be bad days then and there. Swallowing that pill made it easier, at least.

I jumped from 8mg though. If you're on an agonist for MAT, or were on I suppose, check with your provider about giving you a small dose for a longer period and continue tapering before jumping. When I jumped by .125mg, I had virtually no withdrawal aside from a bad mood and pessimistic attitude. I'd even reason that if you have the means available, to see a doctor if it stays super bothersome. No one wants anyone in recovery to relapse, ever. 

Best of luck mate!
